title: Rippling Reverie

outfit_card.silhouette: Jellyfish-inspired voluminous bell silhouette featuring a sculpted seashell corset, layered translucent rippling peplum, cascading fluid ribbons, and delicate spreading crystal wing architecture.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Floating splash-form liquid crystal tiara hovering overhead, accented with suspended droplets, shimmering bubbles, and delicate water-crystal hairpins.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Strapless seashell-scalloped corset encrusted with seed pearls, iridescent crystals, and sea-foam relief, complemented by detached translucent fluid cuffs draping down the wrists.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Multi-tiered iridescent crinoline skirt mimicking an underwater jellyfish bell with trailing sheer aquatic ribbons, styled with spiraling crystal droplet leg vine wraps.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Luminescent crystalline fin-shaped fairy wings refracting prismatic light, surrounded by floating effervescent bubbles and dynamic aquatic ripple ribbons.
